guards: Historical records are not live health or resolution status
Unique issue count, occurrence count and merged repeats are distinct
Same retained occurrence key does not increment; different attempt may increment
Local logs remain available without database; connected refresh may ingest failed background jobs
Export is a local text snapshot, not an upload or full runtime trace
Clearing removes issue history, not runtime logs or business data; subsequent scans may recreate issues
Clear mutates memory before persistence; failure does not prove previous disk/memory state preserved
Unknown/load failure is not confirmed empty; masking is not a comprehensive secret audit
